program_code='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]\n    q = deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in (0, w - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == 0 and not seen[r][c]:\n                seen[r][c] = True\n                q.append((r, c))\n    for c in range(w):\n        for r in (0, h - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == 0 and not seen[r][c]:\n                seen[r][c] = True\n                q.append((r, c))\n    while q:\n        r, c = q.popleft()\n        for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and not seen[nr][nc]:\n                seen[nr][nc] = True\n                q.append((nr, nc))\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == 0 and not seen[r][c]:\n                out[r][c] = 8\n    return out\n'''
